COMPRESS::method
Description
Specifies the preferred compression algorithm.
Syntax
COMPRESS::method prefer [ ’gzip’ | ’deflate’ ]
COMPRESS::method prefer [ ’gzip’ | ’deflate’ ]
Specifies the preferred compression algorithm, either
gzip
or
deflate
.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST_SEND
{
COMPRESS
::
method
prefer
gzip
}
